description: Election Commission - Declare that T. Thiyakaraja as a member of the Vengalacheddikulam PS.
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Vengalacheddikulam Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes at the local government level, including the resignation of a member and the subsequent nomination and declaration of a new member by a recognized political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities elections.
